notes: Starting cards as posted under 'STARTING': the Objective, Death Star II: Throne Room, Your Destiny, Insignificant Rebellion, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points and Oppressive Enforcement; these count toward the 60 (total 60 as published). Several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty.

Posted 'Oppressive Enforcement' dested the Special Edition Effect; the author says to change it to There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement and suggests post-Reflections II swaps (cut the 8 Sense/Alter for Boba Fett In Slave I, Bossk In Hound's Tooth, Masterful Move, Monnok, Sniper x2, No Escape, Counter Assault) — dested as posted, changes not applied.
'This Is Some Rescue' dested the Dark A New Hope interrupt This Is Some Rescue!; Sense and Alter are the Dark Premiere interrupts. The 'DESTINY DISPLAY' block is a destiny count, not cards.
Tournament: 7th on Day 1 of the 2000 Decipher World Championship per the post (the wiki's hub lists him 43rd on Day 2).

Kept general: the post says the list 'helped me take 7th in day one at the worlds this past year' (2000 Decipher World Championship); Day 1 placings are not on the hub, so the claim is quoted in the player_note only.
player_note: The post's description says this deck 'helped me take 7th in day one at the worlds this past year' (the 2000 Decipher World Championship Day 1, October 2000); the list is posted as it was before Reflections II.
